description: Super于1936年推出的旁轴相机。快门速度Novar 3.5/10.5 cm lens in a Compur shutter Tessar 4.5/10.5 cm lens in a Compur shutter Tessar 3.8/10.5 cm lens in a Compur-Rapid shutter Tessar 3.5/10.5 cm lens in a Compur-Rapid shutter。使用6 x 9 cm on 120 type rollfilm. With inlay mask also 4.5x6 cm.。

specs.胶片/画幅: 6 x 9 cm on 120 type rollfilm. With inlay mask also 4.5x6 cm.
specs.快门: Novar 3.5/10.5 cm lens in a Compur shutter Tessar 4.5/10.5 cm lens in a Compur shutter Tessar 3.8/10.5 cm lens in a Compur-Rapid shutter Tessar 3.5/10.5 cm lens in a Compur-Rapid shutter
specs.闪光灯: Socket on shutter, X-synchronisation. Synchro-Compur also M-synchronisation
specs.取景器: reverse Galilean type, integrated in top cover
specs.英文简介: The 531/2 is a folding camera in the Ikonta line, produced by the German company Zeiss Ikon.
